title: Sankhu Residence
intro_text:
Sankhu Residence sits in the historic Sankhu valley, and the design respects that. NextGen drew on traditional Newari building grammar — courtyards, brickwork, carved timber — and updated it for how a contemporary family actually lives today. 
       The exterior reads as a heritage home from the street, while the interiors open up into bright, modern living spaces. It's a project about continuity, not contrast.
